what: Icons lined up like a bottom dock swell up to 1.6x near the cursor, shrinking linearly within 100px of horizontal distance from the cursor, and the size follows a spring (stiffness 277, damping 12, mass .1) that settles without overshoot. Cell positions stay put and icons grow from the bottom, pushing neighbors aside and widening the row accordingly.

options.falloff: ”linear” (default)·”smooth” (smoothstep) — how it shrinks within the radius
options.--fx-size·--fx-pad: (css variable) item side length default 40px · row side margin default 8px

use: ……
note: Duration .15 is the time for the spring to nearly settle (overdamped ζ≈1.14). As in the original, it measures only while moving over the row and returns to 1 on leaving. Not applied on touch devices.

from.where: shared.js bottom dock (.dock__item svg --s·--x, .dock --spread) — original Dock magnify scale 1.6·distance 100·linear·277/12/.1, 4ms step
